current_formulation: Keep owl:sameAs and give each link an error degree from the community structure of its identity cluster (2020).

steps.formulation: owl:sameAs states strict identity of two URI references.
steps.quote: indicates that two URI references actually refer to the same thing

criticism.quote: owl:sameAs can be viewed as encoding only one point on a scale of similarity, one that is often too strong for many of its current uses.

steps.formulation: Identity as one point on a scale of similarity, systematised in a Similarity Ontology. The record date is a year-only placeholder.
steps.quote: can be viewed as encoding only one point on a scale of similarity

criticism.quote: the Similarity Ontology explores too large of a design space to be reliably deployed.

steps.formulation: Consumers choose an interpretation per use: exclusive choice of one URI or a merge of descriptions.
steps.quote: some URIs can be integrated in exclusive manner, i.e. such that only one should be chosen

steps.formulation: Keep owl:sameAs and compute an error degree per link from the community structure of identity clusters.
steps.quote: presented a scalable approach for automatically calculating an error degree for each identity statement
